items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: Jimmy Jones. Yeah, he was out in Des Moines. He come on the boat when Simon taken sick. ... He was a bass player.

ctx.x: He would do that to Piron.
I mean Jimmy Jones. He would do that to Piron. That was on the Steamship Jazz.
Oh, well he's got it all confused.

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: playing with us at Pete Ornans, played bass

ctx.x: You don't have to be afraid to talk, I don't know, you're out there and there.

Yeah, he was. Jimmy Jones? Jimmy Jones. Jimmy. Jimmy. Jimmy. You forgot? Yeah, Jimmy. You know what I was trying to think was playing with us at Pete Ornans, played bass, but we might not have a bass then.
How did Sales rate in those days? He was a nice, fine guitar player. I just wondered who would be among the best guitar players in town. Oh yeah, he was fine, yes indeed.
